messages:
Maya P: Quick sync: proposal for a tiny opt-in header shim to carry compact routing+quota metadata to help console attribution while we finish the header migration. Must be non-breaking and redact any PII.

Liam K: Outline the header shape so SDKs can implement. Keep it size-budgeted for browsers.

Maya P: Compact form suggestion:
X-RW-ROUTE: svc=payments;rh=0x9f
X-RW-Q: b=default;th=sha256:abcd1234
th is salted+truncated hash of tenant. Emit only when client opts in.

Renee H: Console will accept both this and legacy routehint for 30–45 days. We'll store the hash as tenant_h and never display raw tenant. Add note about salt rotation and resolving billing disputes.

Noah S: SDK changes: add client.enableRoutingShim flag (default false). Also add default redaction in logging util so headers are not leaked to error breadcrumbs. Non-breaking semver bump.

Jin C: For the JS SDK, watch header size (browsers drop headers above ~8KB on some proxies). Truncating the hash to 12 chars should be fine. Also provide a server-side feature flag option for orgs that want centralized rollout.

Liam K: Telemetry: tag samples with header_version=shim|legacy and emit a migration metric route.header.migrated. Ops should create a small dashboard tile for % attributed by version and a mismatch rate graph.

Maya P: Rollout plan suggestion:
- Day 0: SDK flags released in py/ts/go (minor bumps); logging util updated to redact headers
- Day 1: internal teams enable in staging and run ingestion tests
- Day 3: 1% canary with obs monitoring
- Day 7: internal 100% rollout; public installs opt-in by default
- Day 37: enable by default for new installs and keep legacy mapping for 45 days

Noah S: Tests: unit tests for header emission and redaction; integration test against staging ingest; assertion that no raw tenant substring exists in sanitized logs.

Renee H: Console will add short explainer text on the rollout tile about why tenants appear as hashes and how to map a hash back for billing (console-only, with salt).

Maya P: ops: deploy-bot, can you schedule a canary window and obs alert?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 2025-03-03T16:00:00Z; created ticket RW-7120.

sdk-bot: created RW-7121 "routing shim: SDK flags + console mapping" and linked owners.

Jin C: I'll open PRs for TS and add a short migration playbook with example queries.

Maya P: thanks. Amanda (oncall) pls monitor alerts. If any cleartext tenant appears in traces, rollback immediately. Tag me on PRs. :white_check_mark:
